content.title: WeightWatchers’s (NASDAQ:WW) Q3: Beats On Revenue, Stock Soars
content.summary: Personal wellness company WeightWatchers (NASDAQ:WW) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 10.8% year on year to $172.1 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $697.5 million at the midpoint came in 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP loss of $5.76 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
